selected_target.predicate: regionInfoMap already has an HbckRegionInfo with a non-null MetaEntry for the same encoded region name
selected_target.exception: IOException: Two entries in hbase:meta are same

reviewed_alternate.source_path: The test runs a one-region-server MiniCluster and calls HbckTestingUtil.doFsck three times. doFsck creates a new HBaseFsck and onlineHbck calls loadMetaEntries, which passes HBaseFsck$3.visit to MetaTableAccessor.fullScanRegions. Thus exact target reach is source-plausible but has not been observed for this selector.
reviewed_alternate.workload_state: The test changes replication peer and WAL queue records; it does not create duplicate hbase:meta rows or overlap a meta mutation with the scan. Each doFsck call owns a new HBaseFsck instance and therefore a fresh regionInfoMap.

fault_mechanism_review.finding: The selected throw depends on visiting the same encoded region name twice with populated MetaEntry state. A fault merely reaching a later visit is insufficient; the later Result must carry a duplicate encoded name.

For recoverable scanner reset exceptions, ClientScanner restarts after the last complete Result by setting the scan start row exclusive. This is explicit duplicate-avoidance logic. The code does not establish that a caught Scan IOException will deliver an already-recorded complete row again.
regionInfoMap is per HBaseFsck instance and clearState clears it. Repeating doFsck in the proposed test does not by itself satisfy the duplicate predicate.

healthy.junit_and_target: Healthy JUnit and exact selected check reached without the selected throw; event-time audit passed with 41 observed-path doors.

bounded_scan_fault_pilot.limitation: Only one of three applied Scan faults had a strict same-Result postfault path; observed Scan door ordinal drifted. Aggregate target retention cannot establish changed duplicate-map state.

decision: Do not run another healthy calibration for TestHBaseFsckReplication solely because it invokes doFsck. The existing MiniCluster workload reaches the scan by source, but current caught-IOException fault mechanism has no source-backed path to duplicate a previously recorded encoded region. Preserve v27 and the bounded Scan pilot; require a concrete row-identity witness or an existing test with a relevant concurrent meta-state change before new fault/full admission. This is a workload/fault-mechanism gap, not a claim that all cluster tests are unsuitable.
